# HttpProtect.jsonMiddleware() method

A middleware that rejects with a JSON error body.

**Signature:**

```typescript
jsonMiddleware(): (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

(req: Request, res: [Response](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.response/)<!-- -->, next: [NextFunction](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.nextfunction/)<!-- -->) =&gt; Promise&lt;void&gt;

An async middleware to hand to `app.use()`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

The usual choice for an API. The body is `{"error":{"type":"HTTP","code":429,"message":"Too Many Requests"}}`<!-- -->, with 418 and `I'm a teapot` for a ban. `Content-Type` is set as described in [HttpProtect.textMiddleware()](/api/http-protect/latest/http-protect.httpprotect.textmiddleware/)<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const protect = new HttpProtect({ redis: existingClient });

app.use(protect.jsonMiddleware());
```
